intervals.label: GRAPES-3 muon telescope operating
intervals.note: The year is that of the muon telescope's continuous operation; the laboratory's own founding date is not stated in the sources read.
intervals.quote: In continuous operation since the year 2000

name: Cosmic Ray Laboratory, Ooty
notes: No operator is recorded: the GRAPES-3 papers list "The GRAPES-3 Experiment, Cosmic Ray Laboratory, Raj Bhavan, Ooty 643001, India" and the Tata Institute of Fundamental Research as affiliations but do not say who operates the laboratory.
The GRAPES-3 collaboration website (grapes-3.tifr.res.in) could not be reached (DNS failure and timeouts, checked 2026-10-26).

summary.plain: An Indian cosmic-ray laboratory in the Nilgiri hills at Ooty, home of the GRAPES-3 air-shower array and muon telescope.
summary.technical: Cosmic Ray Laboratory, Raj Bhavan, Ooty 643001, the address the GRAPES-3 papers give for the experiment (authors are also affiliated with the Tata Institute of Fundamental Research, Mumbai); altitude 2200 m.
